_comment: Claude Code telemetry configuration for a dev container reporting to
Claude Usage Monitor. Copy the `env` block into one of:
~/.claude/settings.json          user-level, every project in this container
Do NOT put a real token in a committed <repo>/.claude/settings.json.
Settings are read at session start — restart Claude Code after editing.
The metrics block is optional. It adds commits, pull requests, active
time, lines of code and edit-acceptance rate, which is what the
Productivity panel on /insights is computed from. Leave it out and
